messages:
mike.c: Quick question — prepping Private deploys for a customer that requires GCP Cloud KMS. Looking for a minimal service account perm checklist, keyring layout recommendations, and a short rotation + audit playbook we can hand off to infra. Any gotchas for envelope encryption?

jess.sec: +1. We should use a dedicated SA per deployment (not per host). Minimal roles: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific CryptoKey, roles/cloudkms.keyRingViewer on the keyRing (if needed), and roles/logging.logWriter on the service account only if the SA emits logs. Avoid broad roles like owner/editor.

rachel.w: For Private (VPC) installs also ensure the SA is bound to the workload identity or the node pool SA? Prefer workload identity if using GKE in customer env. If on-prem, the orchestration user (operator) should have iam.serviceAccounts.actAs limited to a small group.

tom.k: Short sample IAM binding we use in infra repo: 
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "sa_encrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = var.crypto_key_id
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:${var.sa_email}"]
}
```
This gives exact least-priv for encrypt/decrypt.

jess.sec: Envelope encryption notes: always generate a unique data key per object (AES-256), encrypt data key with KMS (Encrypt API) and store the ciphertext along with the object. Do not persist plaintext data keys. Use AEAD libs on the application side.

mike.c: For rotation: do we rotate key versions or create a new key? What about re-wrapping existing data keys?

rachel.w: Prefer key rotation via CryptoKey automatic rotation schedule if you can afford it (e.g., 90 days). GCP creates new key versions; you then use new version for future Encrypt calls. For existing encrypted data keys you need a re-wrap job: decrypt with old key version (KMS Decrypt) then re-encrypt with new version (KMS Encrypt) — or use envelope-rewrap lambda/batch job.

tom.k: We usually do a two-step rolling rewrap job: 
1) Export list of objects whose wrapped DEKs reference key version <= X.
2) Stream and rewrap in small batches (bounded concurrency) to avoid load spikes.
Add monitoring alerts for rewrap failure rate.

sre-bot: deploy:created mike.c triggered infra/kms/crypto-key/setup (CI)

jess.sec: Audit logging: enable Admin Activity and Data Access audit logs for Cloud KMS at the project level. Data Access logs are disabled by default — enable them and export to a dedicated logs project/BigQuery for retention and alerting.

mike.c: Any RBAC changes required on customer side? They want to limit who can create new keys in their project.

rachel.w: Create an org-level role/policy: only our infra SA or a small ops group has roles/cloudkms.admin. Everyone else gets granular roles (viewer, cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter). Use IAM Conditions to limit key creation to specific keyRing locations or labels.

jess.sec: Example gcloud snippets: 
```
# create key ring
gcloud kms keyrings create redwood-prod --location=us-central1 --project=my-cust-project
# create key with rotation every 90d
gcloud kms keys create app-wrapping-key --location=us-central1 --keyring=redwood-prod --purpose=encryption --rotation-period=7776000s
# grant SA encrypt/decrypt
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding app-wrapping-key --location=us-central1 --keyring=redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:infra-sa@my-cust-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

tom.k: Also set labels like "managed-by=redwood" and "env=private" so we can use IAM Conditions and filters in audits.

jess.sec: For Private (air-gapped) customers where KMS API access is restricted, we support bringing-your-own-HSM/KMS via an on-prem key manager adapter. But that requires additional support and different SA patterns — call it out in runbooks.

mike.c: Good. Last: should we recommend CMEK for GCS/BigQuery used in the deployment?

rachel.w: Yes for data residency/compliance. Use the same keyRing but different CryptoKeys per service. Avoid sharing a single key across services to limit blast radius.

jess.sec: TL;DR playbook to hand to infra: 
1) Create keyRing per-region in customer project, label it.
2) Create one wrapping CryptoKey per environment (purpose=encryption) with rotation-period set.
3) Create a dedicated infra service account per Private deployment.
4) Grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific CryptoKey to that SA.
5) Enable Data Access audit logs for Cloud KMS and export to logs project.
6) Schedule periodic rewrap job (batch) with monitoring and retry/backoff.
7) Use IAM Conditions and minimal admin role holders.
8) Document emergency key disable/restore steps in incident runbook.

mike.c: Perfect. I'll write this up into the private-install runbook and ping legal for retention part. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

rachel.w: One more note — test key compromise scenario in staging: disable key version and validate app fallback and rewrap.

mike.c: Will add tests. Done.
